purpose: ADDITIVE reconciliation of the D51 v1.0 adjudication: compliance correction, corrected D51-A reachable-set analysis, corrected D51-B interpretation, and withdrawal of the G quantization repair.

compliance_correction.statement: An exploratory attribution pass DID read VAL GT masks (a GT-dependent Dice computation).
compliance_correction.interpretation_of_original_field: The original artifact field val_gt_read=false describes ONLY the FINAL RECORDED attribution pass (which was GT-free).  It MUST NOT be interpreted as describing the entire original work order.

d51_a.label: D51-A: FINAL_SCORE_REPRESENTATION_MISMATCH
d51_a.preserved_source_fact: A live-f32 prediction can differ from persisted-f16 scoring only at values whose persisted f16 representation is exactly 0.5 (f16 rounding is monotone; x_f32 >= 0.5 => f16(x_f32) >= 0.5, and f16(x_f32) > 0.5 => x_f32 > 0.5).

old_analysis.method: q == k only (remove ALL f16==0.5 pixels); intersection recovered as I = D*(P+G)/2 (canonical epsilon DROPPED)

corrected_analysis.method: union over q in [0, k] and admissible TP/FP overlap j in [max(0, q - min(k, fp)), min(q, min(k, tp))]; EXACT canonical Dice (2*tp + eps)/(2*tp + fp + fn + eps) with eps = 1e-7

comparison.conclusion: The corrected union-over-q + exact-epsilon analysis yields the SAME count as the original analysis; the '128 rows not explainable by D51-A alone' claim SURVIVES.

d51_a.retained_claim: 128 of 390 mismatch rows are not explainable by D51-A alone — SURVIVES the corrected union-over-q + exact-epsilon calculation.

d51_b.label: D51-B: G_REPRODUCTION_GATE_REPRESENTATION_TOO_WEAK_FOR_DOWNSTREAM
d51_b.authority_defect_statement: The v1.14 G gate verifies only the persisted float16 G; Phase27 downstream consumed the ORIGINAL LIVE float32 G; Phase36 downstream also consumes live float32 G; the original Phase27 live-f32 G was NEVER persisted.  Therefore the gate CANNOT prove live-f32 downstream equality.
d51_b.actual_live_f32_difference_statement: This does NOT prove that Phase27 and Phase36 live-f32 G actually differed.  No float32 G authority exists, so the difference is unproven in either direction.

g_quantization_repair.proposed_in_v1_0: generated f32 G -> f16 -> f32 before ROI / 202-D / refiner / S_omega
g_quantization_repair.rationale: Phase27 source proves its downstream consumed the ORIGINAL LIVE float32 G (run_phase27_exec_phaseA.py L295/L306/L318/L339-340/L349/L357).  Quantizing G downstream would change the scientific computation rather than reproduce Phase27.

verdict_explanation: The FINAL-SCORE boundary (D51-A) is CONFIRMED by source.  The G-HANDOFF boundary (D51-B) is an ESTABLISHED AUTHORITY/REPRODUCIBILITY DEFECT, but its CAUSAL contribution to the 390 Dice mismatches is UNPROVEN, because no float32 G authority exists to demonstrate that the live-f32 G actually differed.
